return_reply.text: Aelia kept the flour promise; delivered 4/4. I paid 6 coins. My trust is 0.75. You promise Felix four flour units before dusk

counterfactual.interpretation: Executed removal of one accepted action. Later commands stay at their original times where feasible; infeasible commands are explicitly skipped. Ledger IDs alone are not an outcome difference.

intervention.scheduling: Replay later accepted commands at their original start minutes, or as soon as feasible if an earlier action runs longer.
